approval_chains_subject_exactly_one.name: approval_chains_subject_exactly_one
approval_chains_subject_exactly_one.value:
(
        ("approval_chains"."subject_type" = 'proof' AND (("approval_chains"."quote_id" IS NULL) != ("approval_chains"."inquiry_id" IS NULL)) AND "approval_chains"."schedule_item_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("approval_chains"."subject_type" = 'final_count' AND "approval_chains"."quote_id" IS NOT NULL AND "approval_chains"."inquiry_id" IS NULL AND "approval_chains"."schedule_item_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("approval_chains"."subject_type" = 'asset' AND (("approval_chains"."quote_id" IS NULL) != ("approval_chains"."inquiry_id" IS NULL)) AND "approval_chains"."schedule_item_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("approval_chains"."subject_type" = 'milestone' AND "approval_chains"."schedule_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "approval_chains"."quote_id" IS NULL AND "approval_chains"."inquiry_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("approval_chains"."subject_type" = 'hold_confirmation' AND (("approval_chains"."quote_id" IS NULL) != ("approval_chains"."inquiry_id" IS NULL)) AND "approval_chains"."schedule_item_id" IS NULL)
      )

follow_ups_related_record_required.name: follow_ups_related_record_required
follow_ups_related_record_required.value: "follow_ups"."inquiry_id" is not null or "follow_ups"."quote_id" is not null

inquiries_business_unviewed_idx.name: inquiries_business_unviewed_idx
inquiries_business_unviewed_idx.where: "inquiries"."first_viewed_at" is null and "inquiries"."archived_at" is null and "inquiries"."deleted_at" is null

inquiries_open_deadline_idx.name: inquiries_open_deadline_idx
inquiries_open_deadline_idx.where: "inquiries"."status" in ('new', 'waiting', 'quoted') and "inquiries"."requested_deadline" is not null and "inquiries"."archived_at" is null and "inquiries"."deleted_at" is null

quotes_sent_follow_up_idx.name: quotes_sent_follow_up_idx
quotes_sent_follow_up_idx.where: "quotes"."status" = 'sent' and "quotes"."customer_responded_at" is null and "quotes"."deleted_at" is null

quotes_auto_follow_up_pending_idx.name: quotes_auto_follow_up_pending_idx
quotes_auto_follow_up_pending_idx.where: "quotes"."auto_follow_up_enabled" = true and "quotes"."auto_follow_up_stopped_at" is null and "quotes"."status" = 'sent' and "quotes"."public_viewed_at" is null and "quotes"."customer_responded_at" is null and "quotes"."deleted_at" is null

change_order_lines_target_exactly_one.name: change_order_lines_target_exactly_one
change_order_lines_target_exactly_one.value:
(
        ("change_order_lines"."target_kind" = 'line' AND "change_order_lines"."target_quote_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "change_order_lines"."target_block_id" IS NULL AND "change_order_lines"."target_schedule_item_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("change_order_lines"."target_kind" = 'block' AND "change_order_lines"."target_block_id" IS NOT NULL AND "change_order_lines"."target_quote_item_id" IS NULL AND "change_order_lines"."target_schedule_item_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("change_order_lines"."target_kind" = 'schedule_item' AND "change_order_lines"."target_schedule_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "change_order_lines"."target_quote_item_id" IS NULL AND "change_order_lines"."target_block_id" IS NULL)
      )

invoices_business_quote_active_unique.name: invoices_business_quote_active_unique
invoices_business_quote_active_unique.where: "invoices"."quote_id" is not null and "invoices"."deleted_at" is null and "invoices"."status" <> 'voided'
